literal: Love yields the possession of yearning; that yields the unsought excellence called friendship.
translation: Love produces a yearning for connection with others, and that yearning yields the priceless, effortless excellence called friendship.
modern: அன்பு பிறரிடம் விருப்பம் கொள்ளும் தன்மையைத் தரும்; அந்த விருப்பம் நட்பு என்று சொல்லப்படும் தேடாமலே கிடைக்கும் சிறந்த சிறப்பைத் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet explains the beautiful progression of human relationships starting from love. Love (அன்பு) naturally gives rise to a deep yearning or desire (ஆர்வம்) to connect and be with others. This yearning, in turn, effortlessly yields the supreme excellence of friendship (நண்பு). The word 'நாடா' (unsought) highlights that true friendship is not something one has to laboriously search for; rather, it comes naturally and effortlessly to those who possess a loving heart.
